title: GPOM Chorus: Outbreak Night
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ the chorus: Outbreak Night + the Rumbling
moodboard_intro: Round 2 (Kai: three times the clips, city scale, more zoomed out, big explosions in the distance). 16 new shots from a 10-researcher web sweep, two stills each, escalating outward from the motorway to orbit. Tap This, Maybe or No; your round 1 picks are in the strip at the top.
storyboard_intro: Kai's 7 picks in film order across the 32 beats (11 s). Each frame has three ways to shoot it. The camera work is the point: pick the move per frame, and leave a note if you want a different one.

beats.name: Inside the car
beats.blurb: A jammed evacuation motorway at night, from inside one car. The cup of water on the dashboard ripples on the kick, and we don't yet know why.

beats.name: The cars wake
beats.blurb: Every headlight flips cold white at once, the locks drop, and the wheels turn with no hands on them.

beats.name: Fire down the lanes
beats.blurb: A chain of fire runs down the stopped traffic. People flee, small and seen from behind.

beats.name: The cranes stand up
beats.blurb: The scale break. The port's container cranes pull free of their rails and stand. That was the tremor.

beats.name: The rank walks
beats.blurb: A line of cranes walks across the skyline in step on the kick. A British terraced street for scale.

beats.name: The foot
beats.blurb: One foot comes down on a motorway flyover. It is here.

beats.name: Everywhere
beats.blurb: One beat each: Rotterdam, Shanghai, New York.

beats.name: The bookend
beats.blurb: The opening frame again, with the driver's seat empty. The car drives itself in a convoy toward a town. Then black, into the war.

beats.name: Wider: motorway to district
beats.blurb: The jam and the depots from above and far off.

beats.name: The cities
beats.blurb: London, Liverpool, the Thames, the seaside, the viaduct: big blasts in the distance, people small in front.

beats.name: The regions and the country
beats.blurb: Power stations, farmland, Dover, then Britain going dark from orbit.

cut.picked: Kai 9 Nov: sequence E (London) of six, on https://claude.ai/artifact/FysUZ1XJxJhDobBStkGC9p; empty-car ending removed
